descriptions.zh: 调用本接口前，您需要先为集群安装或升级安全策略组件。具体操作，请参见[启用安全策略管理](~~359818~~)。
descriptions.en: Before calling this operation, install or upgrade the security policy component for the cluster. For more information, see [Enable security policy management](~~359818~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs update-resources-delete-protection --cluster-id c850429a2287b4d968e27e87a49210000 --namespace default --resource-type services --resources test --enable true --region cn-hangzhou
